Likewise, the employee commits to obtain the proper authorization for each expense, regardless of the amount, and to certify that such expenses are deductible and in compliance with the applicable tax policies. This means that prior to any payment or disbursement of cash from BLH accounts, payments must be approved.
The employee also acknowledges that in cases where expenses are not deductible, they are fully authorized by the Company's designees and will be handled under exception.
Furthermore, it is understood and accepted that failure to comply with these procedures and policies may lead to disciplinary proceedings that may result in termination of employment.
